title: Sangyoon Yi
text:
Sangyoon Yi
Assistant Professor Department of Statistics Oklahoma State University

title: Research
text: My research focuses on high-dimensional statistics, multi-view data integration, mediation analysis, multiple testing, and statistical methods for microbiome and multi-omics data. I am particularly interested in developing principled and interpretable methods for complex, structured data.
